   <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 17:12:34 +0200</pubDate>
   <description>New measurements from Saint-Gervais-Mont-Blanc show Western Europe's highest peak at 4,807.47 metres, almost two metres higher than in 2023. Experts say the change is due to the thickness of the snow and ice cap.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Guinea-Bissau denies it has approved controversial vaccine trial in newborns</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/14/guinea-bissau-vaccine-hepatitis-b-trial-denial</link>
      <description><p>Health minister says government ‘did not authorize’ Danish-led hepatitis B trial in babies backed by RFK Jr</p><p>Guinea-Bissau has not approved the controversial hepatitis B study in newborns that would be funded by the US government and private partners, the African country’s minister of health said on Tuesday.</p><p>The study, which would not investigate the safety or effectiveness of vaccines but would instead track “nonspecific” health outcomes like overall mortality or neurodevelopmental conditions, has been championed by Robert F Kennedy Jr, secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime anti-vaccine activist.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/14/guinea-bissau-vaccine-hepatitis-b-trial-denial">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/09/navanethem-navi-pillay-wins-nobel-peace-prize</link>
      <description><p>Committee recognises work of South African who chaired UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza</p><p></p><p>The Nobel peace prize has been awarded to Navi Pillay, the South African former UN human rights chief who chaired the UN commission <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/16/israel-committed-genocide-in-gaza-says-un-inquiry">that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza</a>.</p><p>The Norwegian Nobel committee said Pillay, who is serving as a judge at the international court of justice (ICJ), has “shown that legal measures can help prevent acts of war and violence”.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/09/navanethem-navi-pillay-wins-nobel-peace-prize">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Isaias strengthens to become first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 season</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/oct/09/isaias-strengthens-first-atlantic-hurricane-2026</link>
      <description><p>Storm expected to make landfall on US’s northern Gulf coast with risk of flash floods and isolated river flooding</p><p>Isaias has become the first Atlantic hurricane of the 2026 season, with wind speeds of 80mph and a minimum pressure of 975mb. It is expected to strengthen to a category 2 hurricane as it approaches the US’s northern Gulf coast on Friday, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA).</p><p>As a result of <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/sep/26/what-is-el-nino-causes-can-we-reduce-risks">the strong El Niño</a>, it has been a notably quiet Atlantic hurricane season. The first hurricane of the season has not formed this late since 8 October 1905, which pre-dates the satellite era (1960s) for tracking hurricanes that has allowed for more non-landfall hurricanes to be discovered.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/oct/09/isaias-strengthens-first-atlantic-hurricane-2026">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Egyptian journalists plan weekend protest over detention of six colleagues</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/oct/09/egypt-six-journalists-matsadaash-protest-over-detentions</link>
      <description><p>Matsadaash staff allege torture and forced confessions after being held on charges of working for Muslim Brotherhood</p><p>Egyptian journalists are planning a new protest in Cairo this weekend after <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/04/egyptian-journalist-faces-terrorism-charges-entire-newsroom-detained-matsadaash-press-freedom">six colleagues were charged with terrorism offences</a> amid allegations they had been tortured in police detention.</p><p>Last week, Egyptian authorities arrested the journalists, from the independent factchecking and investigative platform Matsadaash, accusing them in a statement of being unlicensed and producing false news on behalf of the outlawed <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/muslim-brotherhood">Muslim Brotherhood</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/oct/09/egypt-six-journalists-matsadaash-protest-over-detentions">Continue reading...</a></description>

News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/</link><lastBuildDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 15:33:22 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>Americas</category><title>In Phoenix, young ultra-conservatives look to carry on Charlie Kirk’s legacy</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261014-in-phoenix-young-ultra-conservatives-look-to-carry-on-charlie-kirk-s-legacy</link><description>
More than a year after the assassination of far-right influencer Charlie Kirk in September 2025, young activists from the organisation he co-founded, Turning Point USA, are working tirelessly to honour his legacy by rallying the youth vote ahead of the US midterm elections.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/33439222-c643-11f1-b3d7-3774aeac812a/w:1024/p:16x9/main-89.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/33439222-c643-11f1-b3d7-3774aeac812a/w:1024/p:16x9/main-89.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">5069ad7c-c6f8-11f1-aaf1-e544774ab7eb</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 14:37:37 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/33439222-c643-11f1-b3d7-3774aeac812a/w:1024/p:16x9/main-89.png">© Studio Graphique, FMMM</source><dc:creator>Barbara GABEL</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Houthis say targeted Saudi oil giant Aramco, vow more attacks</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261014-houthis-say-targeted-saudi-oil-giant-aramco-vow-more-attacks</link><description>
Yemen's Houthis said Wednesday they had targeted facilities belonging to Saudi Aramco, after Saudi officials reported a strike on a building in an area housing the energy giant's operations centre. Powerful explosions meanwhile rattled the Saudi capital, as the coalition fighting the Houthis said it had intercepted a missile fired by the Iran-backed group towards Riyadh.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3b6e2700-c7c4-11f1-99b1-77317c09f325/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261014-131055-131242-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3b6e2700-c7c4-11f1-99b1-77317c09f325/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261014-131055-131242-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">408ae05c-c7c4-11f1-9f5c-bd94fb508e46</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 14:00:14 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Ceuta an 'inalienable' part of Spain, king says on key visit</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261014-ceuta-an-inalienable-part-of-spain-king-says-on-key-visit</link><description>
King Felipe VI on Tuesday said Ceuta and Melilla were "an inalienable part" of Spain as he made a landmark visit to the north African territories claimed by neighbouring Morocco. But the monarch, who rarely makes political interventions, emphasised Spain's need to "maintain good neighbourly relations" with Rabat after July's unprecedented migrant surge into Ceuta strained historically delicate ties. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid, Spain.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/edd0cb60-c7cd-11f1-b1d3-e362370cce2e/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261014-131306-131645-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/edd0cb60-c7cd-11f1-b1d3-e362370cce2e/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261014-131306-131645-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">f2fcee52-c7cd-11f1-8070-654043f5fad8</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 13:58:45 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Ukraine accuses SpaceX of crippling military missions as ties with US worsen</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261014-ukraine-accuses-spacex-of-crippling-military-missions-as-ties-with-us-worsen</link><description>
Ukraine accused Elon Musk's SpaceX on Wednesday of limiting Starlink services, crippling its drones, as Russian missiles knocked out power stations in attacks President Volodymyr Zelensky called "ostentatious disrespect" to Donald Trump. Kyiv's relationship with Washington has taken a sharp turn for the worse since US President Trump abruptly lifted sanctions on Russian diesel last week and publicly turned on Zelensky. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/775fbc9c-c7ce-11f1-aa9c-3774aeac812a/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261014-140439-140826-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/775fbc9c-c7ce-11f1-aa9c-3774aeac812a/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261014-140439-140826-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">7c5809b6-c7ce-11f1-b081-ab756fb80443</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 13:57:22 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Cornell University bans fraternity parties after alleged gang rape</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261014-cornell-university-bans-fraternity-parties-after-alleged-gang-rape</link><description>
Cornell University will ban parties and social events at fraternity houses until the end of the academic year, its president said on Tuesday, responding to the outcry over an alleged ​gang rape on ‌campus in 2024. The measure is the strongest reaction yet from Cornell's leadership to a lawsuit ⁠filed by a former undergraduate, Jane Doe, alleging seven men sexually assaulted her during a party. Over the last several weeks, the Ivy League school in Ithaca, New York, and its ‌president, Michael Kotlikoff, have come under heavy criticism over its response to ⁠the allegations.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/22e942ae-c7cf-11f1-ae0f-53993c5f1f18/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261014-141822-142007-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/22e942ae-c7cf-11f1-ae0f-53993c5f1f18/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261014-141822-142007-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">27cf59e8-c7cf-11f1-b86e-5b76a7f17b7e</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 13:55:11 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

<![CDATA[ Latest from Space.com ]]> https://www.space.com/feeds.xml Wed, 14 Oct 2026 15:00:00 +0000 en <![CDATA[ 'The X-Files' is officially returning as Hulu picks up Ryan Coogler's 'reimagining' of the sci-fi icon ]]> The truth is once again out there, as Disney & Hulu confirmed today that they have picked up a new "The X-Files" show for a full season.

Described as a "reimagining" of the classic series, the project comes from Ryan Coogler, the acclaimed writer and director of "Creed", "Black Panther", and "Sinners", and will star Danielle Deadwyler and Himesh Patel.

The show's premise will sound very familiar to fans of the original, as it centers on "two highly decorated but vastly different FBI agents who form an unlikely bond when they are assigned to a long-shuttered division devoted to cases involving unexplained phenomena."

"I've loved 'The X-Files' for a long time, so getting the chance to write and direct the pilot has meant a great deal to me," said Coogler. "What Chris Carter created is special, and we wanted to honor everything that made the original series connect with so many people while also finding our own way into that world."

Coogler wrote, directed, and executive produced the pilot for this new show, which impressed executives over at Hulu enough to give the show the greenlight. He's certainly got the pedigree when it comes to "spooky", as "Sinners" was a modern horror masterpiece, winning the Best Original Screenplay Oscar at the 2025 Academy Awards. The X-Files is one of the greatest sci-fi shows of all time, and we can't wait to see what a modern take on the classic formula looks like.

Alongside the leads, the cast will include Amy Madigan, Ben Foster, Devery Jacobs, Lochlyn Munro, Tantoo Cardinal, Joel D. Montgrand, Sofia Grace Clifton, and Hollywood legend Steve Buscemi (an inspired casting choice for any show, but especially here. He looks like a man who's seen the truth).

Both Coogler and Hulu are being coy about how this new series will fit into the continuity of the original show. It's being described as a reimagining, but they've stopped short of calling it a reboot, which could leave the door open for Mulder and Scully to return in some capacity.

The original creator of "The X-Files", Chris Carter, is also on board as an executive producer, which is great news for fans who are hoping this new incarnation keeps the spirit of the original alive.

There is no confirmed release date yet, but Ryan Coogler's The X-Files project will launch exclusively on Hulu (US) & Disney+ (UK).

Watch The X-Files on Hulu (US):
Hulu with Ads: $11.99/month or $119.99/year
Premium (No Ads): $18.99/month

]]> <![CDATA[ Cosmic 'jellyfish' wows skywatchers after SpaceX launch | Space photo of the day for Oct. 14, 2026 ]]>

Did you see a gigantic, glowing jellyfish in the night sky early on Tuesday morning (Oct. 13)? If so, it's not an alien invasion (sorry); it was SpaceX launching its latest mission to the International Space Station (ISS).

What is it?

Just before dawn on Tuesday (Oct. 13), a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, carrying to space a robotic Dragon capsule filled with thousands of pounds of cargo.

The liftoff kicked off CRS-35, the 35th mission that SpaceX is flying to the ISS as part of the company's Commercial Resupply Services agreement with NASA. Under the CRS contract, SpaceX has been sending cargo including medical supplies, food, clothing, scientific experiments and more to the space station.

It will take Dragon a couple of days to reach the orbiting lab. If all goes to plan, the capsule will autonomously dock with the ISS' Harmony module around 11 a.m. EDT (1500 GMT) on Thursday (Oct. 15).

Why is it incredible?

Imagine you wake up early in the morning. Perhaps you're rushing to get ready for work, or maybe you're just having a quiet moment with your coffee in the pre-dawn twilight. Then imagine you look out the window and see what looks like a gigantic, glowing jellyfish made up of orange and blue light and gas stretching across much of the slowly brightening sky.

If you're not expecting such a sight, or it's your first time seeing the remnants of a rocket launch, this would probably catch you off-guard. But don't worry; there isn't anything dangerous about this sight.

This "jellyfish" is created by the water vapor and carbon dioxide that are expelled by the rocket after takeoff. In the cold upper skies, those gases start to freeze into ice crystals, flowing off of and behind the rocket. If a launch occurs around dusk or dawn, sunlight hits this flowing plume of frozen gases while the ground and skies remain mostly dark, resulting in a uniquely spectacular (albeit, unusual) view.

]]> <![CDATA[ The 1st SpaceX Starship to survive a launch to space just came home to its launch site ]]>

Nearly three months after surviving its launch to space and a tumultuous trial at sea, the first Starship spacecraft to survive its ocean splashdown has returned to Starbase.

SpaceX shared new photos and video of Ship 40, the Starship upper stage that launched on the developing vehicle's 13th flight test, as it completed the final stretch of its journey back to the company's South Texas facility. Now, the towering spacecraft is upright inside Starbase's Megabay hangar alongside a trio of its successor spacecraft, themselves bound for space, but not before an evaluation of Ship 40 can lend SpaceX engineers some valuable insights.

Ship 40 is the first Starship upper stage to return to its launch site after flying in space, offering SpaceX engineers an unprecedented opportunity to study hardware that survived the intense conditions of atmospheric reentry. "It will provide first-of-its-kind data on a flown Starship heatshield, Raptor engines, avionics, and more," SpaceX wrote in a post on X Oct. 13.

The spacecraft launched atop SpaceX's Super Heavy Booster 20 on July 24, and completed a suborbital flight that ended with a controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean. Unlike previous Ship splashdowns, though, which have exploded after tipping over into the water, Ship 40 remained largely intact and afloat.

That unexpected survival prompted SpaceX to engage in an ambitious recovery effort that included towing the 171-foot (52 meter) stage though rough seas over the course of 24 days. At the time, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk expressed doubts that the company's recovery efforts would be successful. Despite the challenging conditions, Ship arrived off the shores of Australia's Christmas Island in August.

Once in the calmer Christmas waters, SpaceX engineers took time to perform a vehicle inspection and collect a number of heat shield samples from the spacecraft's belly. From there, Ship 40 was loaded onto "Forte," a massive, semi-submersible transport ship for the long seaward journey back to Texas.

Forte arrived at the Port of Brownsville on Oct. 7, wrapping up the longest stretch of Ship 40's return nearly two months after its liftoff. The spacecraft was subsequently transported over land back to Starbase and positioned for reorientation outside the Megabay. It has since been lifted to a vertical position and moved inside the bay alongside three other Ship upper stages still under assembly.

While SpaceX has successfully recovered a trio of Super Heavy boosters using the mechanical arms of its Starbase launch tower, the company has yet to return a Starship upper stage to its launch site under its own power. The return of Ship 40 will give SpaceX engineers the opportunity to study the vehicle from top to bottom as they fine-tune the systems needed to do just that. Its return marks a milestone in SpaceX's efforts to develop Starship as a rapidly reusable launch vehicle, with lessons from the recovered spacecraft potentially informing future vehicle designs and recovery operations.

Ship 40's immediate successor, Ship 41, launched on Flight 14 before 40's return to Starbase. Although 41 didn't survive its splashdown in the Pacific Ocean, the mission marked Starship's first orbital flight, and included the successful deployment of 26 next-generation Starlink V3 satellites.

Musk has said Starship's next launch, Flight 15, could feature the first attempt to catch the Ship upper stage using the same chopstick-like arms on the vehicle's launch tower, provided the spacecraft meets the necessary conditions for a safe return. SpaceX has not announced an official launch date for Starship's next flight, but, based on the testing progress of the Ship and Super Heavy in line for the mission, it is likely to fly within the next month or so.

]]> <![CDATA[ Four years ago, NASA punched an asteroid. Europe's Hera probe arrives this month to inspect the wreckage ]]> NASA's DART mission made a cosmic mess four years ago — and now a new spacecraft is ready to scout out exactly what the first-of-its-kind collision accomplished.

The Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) spacecraft slammed into a small space rock called Dimorphos on Sept. 26, 2022, in humanity's first test of planetary defense. That's the field dedicated to protecting Earth from the possibility of a calamitous asteroid impact, and DART mimicked how humans could change the orbit of a threatening space rock, taking it off its collision course.

The mission definitely succeeded, shortening the little asteroid's orbit around a larger rock called Didymos by about 33 minutes. But in order to make the most of the experiment, scientists ensured a second spacecraft would follow DART at a more leisurely pace. That decision will pay off this month with the arrival of a European Space Agency (ESA) spacecraft dubbed Hera, which launched in October 2024, two years after DART's impact.

"Hera wants to be the detective, like Inspector Colombo, going back to the crash scene," said Patrick Michel, a planetary scientist at the French National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS) and principal investigator of the Hera mission.

Scientists have been able to do limited monitoring of the Didymos system over the years with telescopes both on the ground and in space. That's how they calculated the basic change to the orbit, and they've built a basic sketch of what happened.

"We know that there was a lot of material kicked up," said Angela Stickle, a planetary scientist at Johns Hopkins University's Applied Physics Laboratory affiliated with both missions. "We know that we probably left a pretty significant mark on Dimorphos."

But the story isn't over and scientists are far from satisfied. No one knows how big a crater the impact left, or whether it completely rearranged all the asteroid's boulders. There are hints Dimorphos is now tumbling, and material may have moved between it and the larger Didymos.

Even the change to the orbit is complicated, said Cristina Thomas, a planetary astronomer at Northern Arizona University affiliated with both missions: The time Dimorphos took to circle Didymos was still changing some six months after impact, for reasons that aren't clear. "This thing that we thought was going to be very cut and dry turned out to be really interesting and complicated," Thomas said.

That's where Hera comes in, with its first arrival maneuver scheduled for Oct. 15. During three careful braking maneuvers, the spacecraft will slow down and approach the space rocks. Assuming everything goes smoothly, by early November, the spacecraft will come within 20 miles (30 kilometers) of the two rocks and begin its early science observations, then move even closer in early December.

Mission personnel can't wait for their first glimpses of Dimorphos — the first time scientists will visit someplace they've seen before without knowing what they'll find. "For us, it's like a new world," Michel said. "The new image won't have anything to do with the previous one, so that's really exciting."

In addition to mapping the two asteroids and seeing what kind of crater the impact left, scientists will also have their eyes peeled for any pieces of the DART spacecraft, although they don't expect to find anything. "We were coming in really fast, so typically, the whole spacecraft you would expect to just kind of shatter or melt," Stickle said. The only sliver of possibility is that part of the two long solar panels stretching off the spacecraft may have snapped off and survived. (The appendages may also have turned the crater shape into an oval.)

In January, once Hera has settled in, it will release two tiny companions that have piggybacked out to Dimorphos. One, called Milani, will identify the composition of materials on and around Dimorphos. The other, Juventas, will use radar to peer inside Dimorphos — the first time scientists have ever been able to study the interior of a space rock directly. Juventas will end its mission by landing on the small asteroid, and Milani may attempt a landing as well.

The trio of spacecraft will operate in tandem throughout early 2027, and the main spacecraft will operate at least through September 2027. All told, they will give scientists an unprecedented look at the pair of asteroids — the first binary asteroid a spacecraft has ever studied in detail. And the Didymos–Dimorphos duo is a good one to visit first. "It's very ordinary, and I mean that in the best possible way," Thomas said.

Ordinary except, of course, for that time humans punched it, opening the door for the Hera mission to explore the previously unremarkable rocks. And finally, that moment is just around the corner.

"Nothing really worries me," Michel said of the spacecraft's arrival. "It's really just excitement now."

]]> <![CDATA[ Scientists discover that some of the universe's biggest explosions may have never happened at all ]]> Now you see them, now you don't. Scientists have discovered that some of the universe's most powerful explosions, hypernovas, may not happen at all.

These explosions, known as hypernovas, were first proposed to explain unusual stars in the halo of our galaxy, the Milky Way, and in a neighboring dwarf galaxy. It was suggested that these stars could only form from the debris of an explosion 10 times more powerful than the 'average' supernovas.

The team behind these new findings suggests that ordinary supernovas could actually account for these stars when the uneven or non-spherical way they fling out matter is considered.

"If we look at a supernova today, the star's materials are not spread evenly. Oxygen might predominantly fly in one direction, sulphur in another. New stars might form from a mix of pieces of the supernova, not its overall mix of elements," team leader Anmol Aggarwal of University College London (UCL) said in a statement. "We developed mathematical models that took account of this and found in all cases that stars with a very unusual mix of ingredients were most likely formed from ordinary supernovas.

"All the evidence we see for hypernovae is suddenly gone."

Hypernova vs. supernova: What's the difference?

Supernovas occur when massive stars run out of fuel for nuclear fusion, effectively ending their lives. This results in the star's core collapsing, sending shockwaves rippling through its outer layers, causing explosions we call supernovas.

Hypernovas are proposed to occur in a similar way, but for an even more massive and rapidly spinning star. This results in a vastly more energetic explosion.

When supernovas or hypernovas happen, they fling elements that the dying star has forged throughout its lifetime into their surrounding cosmic environments. These elements eventually become the building blocks of the next generation of stars.

That means analyzing the chemical signatures of stars can tell stellar scientists about their family histories.

"Just before a star goes supernova, it has layers like an onion, with heavier elements at the center and lighter ones further out. Our model looks at how much material from each layer or each region would be needed to fit the observed star," Ralph Schoenrich of Mullard Space Science Laboratory at UCL said. "We still don’t know how well the supernova material gets mixed before it forms new stars. That is despite decades of work in this area. Our research suggests some mixing goes on, but incomplete mixing.

"We need to take this into account in our models of how chemicals evolve in galaxies and of how the interstellar medium works."

The team began their investigation by observing four stars that are suspected to have been forged from material ejected in a hypernova explosion. Three of those stars were more likely to have been created after supernovas, the team concluded.

The scientists then studied a single red giant star in the halo of the Milky Way with an odd chemical composition, including an overabundance of heavy elements like silver and uranium. These are too heavy to be forged in the cores of all but the most massive stars, the kind of stars that go hypernova.

Such elements could also be created when two massive and dense stellar remnants called neutron stars collide and merge. However, this star doesn't have certain other heavy elements that would be present after a neutron star collision.

This team considered the origins of this star using a model of the Milky Way that has been rapidly enriched with elements heavier than hydrogen and helium, which astronomers call metals, via the death of the first generation of stars.

The rapid speed at which the star spins and the fact it exists at the outskirts of the Milky Way led the team to conclude that this star escaped a metal-poor dwarf galaxy and was eventually dragged into our galaxy. The event that created it, they concluded, was the combination of a neutron star merger and an ordinary supernova.

No hypernova required. An asymmetrical supernova would be enough, the scientists found.

The team's research was published as two papers in the journal Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society.

]]> <![CDATA[ On this day in space! Oct. 13, 1773: Astronomer Charles Messier discovers the Whirlpool Galaxy before we ever knew it was a galaxy ]]>

On Oct. 13, 1773, a French astronomer named Charles Messier discovered the "Whirlpool Galaxy," also known as Messier 51, or M51.

Charles Messier was scanning the sky for objects that could confuse comet hunters when he catalogued the galaxy as M51. However, Messier wasn't able to see the spiral structure, and he didn't identify it as a galaxy.

Seventy-two years later, another astronomer named William Parsons saw the whirlpool shape, but he thought it was a spiral nebula. Eventually, Edwin Hubble found out that M51 and other features like it were actually galaxies.

Why it mattered

The Whirlpool Galaxy is located about 31 million light-years from Earth and just might be the textbook case of a spiral galaxy. But in 1773, it was just one of 51 (at the time of its discovery) of "comet-like 'objects to avoid'" in the night sky.

The Whirlpool Galaxy's designation as M51 marks it as the 51st non-comet object catalogued by Messier, who was the chief astronomer of the Marine Observatory in Paris dedicated to studying comets. According to a NASA account, Messier stumbled across his first non-comet object, M1 (also known as the Crab Nebula), while studying a comet in 1758. The objects looked like fuzzy blobs like comets, but didn't move like a comet. By 1773, at the time he first spotted M51, he had catalogued over four dozen such objects to help prevent astronomers from mistaking them for comets.

The Whirlpool Galaxy appears as a dazzling spiral in images by the Hubble Space Telescope, and has a magnitude of 8.4 on the brightness scale used by astronomers. That means it can be observed through a small telescope ("most easily during May," NASA says) in the constellation Venatici (the Hunting Dogs) in the northern sky, just below the handle of the Big Dipper star pattern.

Scientists suspsect the Whirpool Galaxy gets is striking spiral shape from a close interaction with its neighbor galaxy NGC 5195, which may have passed through M51's main disk about 500 million years ago, scientists with NASA's Spitzer Space Telescope have said.

"This gravitational tug of war may also have triggered an increased level of star formation in M51," they added in a statement. "The companion galaxy's pull would be inducing extra starbirth by compressing gas, jump-starting the process by which stars form."

]]> <![CDATA[ See the original Galileo shuttle from 'Star Trek' in its new home at the Original Series Set Tour in New York ]]> Nostalgia is a hell of a thing, especially when it comes to sci-fi. For "Star Trek" fans wanting to mark the franchise's 60th anniversary this year, a geeky pilgrimage to upstate New York should be on the cards. Why? Because alongside the splendid autumnal colors, they can steer over to Ticonderoga to behold the newly installed Galileo shuttlecraft.

After a complete two-year restoration project in 2012 headed up by superfan and collector Adam Schneider, this iconic fictional spacecraft, seen by millions in seven episodes over three seasons of "Star Trek: The Original Series," was recently relocated from its former home at the Johnson Space Center Museum in Houston, Texas.

It's now on permanent loan to James Cawley and his Star Trek Original Series Set Tour in historic downtown Ticonderoga, New York, where it joins a family of painstakingly detailed sets based on the official "Star Trek" blueprints.

'Galileo is still the property of Space Center, and it was on display there since 2013," Schneider tells Space. "It went to USS Intrepid for the 50th anniversary of 'Star Trek,' displayed under the Enterprise Space Shuttle. You had the Enterprise with Enterprise's little shuttle Galileo adjacent, which was an extraordinary picture. It went back to Space Center, but it takes up an enormous amount of room, and they took it off display after 8 years."

It seemed a shame to have the shuttle out of sight, so Schneider got to work finding a new home for the shuttle. "Since I was on the board, I tried to figure out a place where it could be aimed", recounts Schneider. "The Star Trek Tour made the most sense, so I worked with Space Center to relocate it, and it arrived a couple of years ago."

Hoping to give the restored relic its own private docking bay due to its enormity, faithful fans raised hundreds of thousands of dollars via a Kickstarter campaign led by Brian Mix and David Harvey, and built a beautiful building addition for Galileo to be safely ensconced in.

"My wife Leslie and I had been tending over the Galileo for a number of years, and it's now successfully displayed there in New York for all to see," Schneider adds. "It's an extraordinary thing to see person if you have not. It's not the size of a chair, it’s the size of a bus. It looks gorgeous in its new space, and if you’re a space aficionado or Star Trek aficionado, that’s even more reason to get involved with this thing."

Opening weekend for the general public at Star Trek Tours to see the newest member of the museum was Sept. 18-20, 2026, and the Galileo was the star attraction. Branded Trekonderoga Weekend, the unveiling ceremony was attended by Assemblymen Dan Stec and Dan Simpson, and 'Trek' luminaries George Takei, Jonathan Frakes, and Brent Spiner.

"We're certainly thrilled that we were able to work with Adam and NASA to get it here permanently," Cawley tells Space. "Then to get it on display properly and share it with all the fans and make sure that it's on exhibit for many years to come. We’re just outside of the village of Lake George, so we’re part of the greater Lake George tourism region.

"You've seen it on television, and now you’re the caretaker of it. What an honor to be able to do that. It’s the simplicity of the Galileo that makes it so unique. It's Matt Jefferies' whole design ethic for the original series. Less is more. It catches your eye in a specific way. It has a blocky-type silhouette and actually it really complements the Enterprise because you really see the shape difference. Everything has that mid-century modern aesthetic. It's just timeless."

For Cawley, being custodian and host of the screen-used Galileo is like a dream. This 23-foot-long mock-up was part of the USS Enterprise's basic design and was rescued from demolition some 14 years ago when Schneider purchased it at a 2012 memorabilia auction for $61,000.

"We had a great rousing opening weekend with it, and business has been very steady into October with people asking about it. It's going to be a big cornerstone to the tour. I think people are becoming aware that it’s here and they’re making a pilgrimage to come because of it."

For more prices, hours, and more information on the Star Trek Original Series Set Tour in Ticonderoga, New York, visit them at https://startrektour.com or call 518-503-5497. You can also see the Galileo in action in Star Trek: The Original Series on Paramount+.

]]> <![CDATA[ Earth's poles shifted surprisingly fast during the age of dinosaurs, ancient sea levels reveal ]]> The location of Earth's geographic poles has changed several times over the past 320 million years in a process known as true polar wander, according to measurements of ancient flooding brought about by sea level changes resulting from our planet's crust shifting relative to Earth's spin axis.

Such a shift can affect climate, both on local scales and globally, as regions that were by the poles find themselves moving down to lower latitudes and vice versa. This can then affect atmospheric circulation patterns, which affect climate across the world.

The changes would have affected the environments in which life developed and evolved, from the age of the dinosaurs through to some of our oldest primate ancestors.

True polar wander is not the same as a change in the rotational axis of the Earth. Currently, Earth spins at an angle of 23.4 degrees relative to the plane of its orbit around the sun, and this rotational axis can vary periodically over tens of thousands of years as a result of the Milankovitch cycles caused by the gravitational pull of the sun and planets.

True polar wander is different. Here, the angle of Earth's spin axis does not change relative to its orbital plane. Instead, Earth's crust and mantle shift relative to that rotational axis. This is because Earth is not perfectly spherical. Instead, it is oblate, with Earth's rotation causing the equator to bulge out and the poles to slightly flatten. Because Earth is not spherical, it has multiple axes of inertia, the largest one being aligned with the rotational axis.

These axes need to be balanced to prevent Earth's rotation from becoming chaotic. However, plate tectonics and indeed the Milankovitch cycles can upset that balance of mass, for example by causing more continental crust to congregate in one hemisphere than another.

To rebalance things, Earth's crust and mantle must become decoupled from our planet's core, which stays aligned with the rotational axis. In physical terms, if there is more continental crust in one hemisphere, the crust and mantle might rotate in that direction relative to the rotational axis and the Earth's core in order to balance itself. This sees the geographical locations of the poles change, hence the name 'true polar wander'.

Currently, true polar wander takes place at a rate of 10 centimeters (4 inches) per year, but figuring out when and how fast true polar wander has occurred in the past is not without its difficulties, not least since plate tectonics can mask and even mimic the signal of true polar wander.

Previous studies relied on paleomagnetism, the study of residual magnetic traces in ancient rocks, since the orientation of those magnetic traces would have varied depending upon where that rock was located relative to Earth's magnetic field. Alas, it's not a terribly accurate means of measuring true polar wander and scientists arrived at substantially different conclusions using this technique.

Nevertheless, based on paleomagnetism, scientists had concluded that true polar wander had been negligible, or slow to proceed, in the distant past. However, new results from researchers at the Centre for Planetary Habitability at the University of Oslo in Norway, led by Mathew Domeier, have shown this not to be the case.

Domeier's team looked through the geological record to track how sea level has changed across millions of years. True polar wander would bring about an identifiable pattern in sea-level changes as the oceans reacted in response to changes in the mass distribution of the planet. The sea level changes would be equal but opposite between hemispheres — sea level rises on one side of one hemisphere would be matched by rises on the other side of the opposite hemisphere, creating a 'quadrupolar' effect.

By using statistical modeling on maps of sea level changes across intervals of 10 million years, Domeier's team identified four periods of true polar wander: in the early Jurassic period 190—200 million years ago, the late Jurassic — early Cretaceous period 140—150 million years ago, during the mid-Cretaceous 90—100 million years ago and from the Oligocene period 30 million years ago through to the Miocene 20 million years ago.

The results show that, contrary to established opinion, true polar wander can happen in bursts that are relatively fast on geological timescales, with the results showing that during the episodes of true polar wander the Earth's surface shifted by as much as 0.6 degrees per million years relative to the spin axis. This is slow by human standards, but fairly fast on geological timescales, certainly quicker than plate tectonics.

Domeier's team were also able to rule out a suspected case of true polar wander around 300 million years ago when the last great supercontinent, Pangea, migrated northwards. It turns out that Pangea's movements were entirely due to plate tectonics.

The findings were published on Oct. 1 in the journal Science.

 <title>V Praze panuje mezi lídry řevnivost až nenávist, výjimkou jsou Portlík s Hlaváčkem, všímá si Dolejší</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/volby/v-praze-panuje-mezi-lidry-revnivost-az-nenavist-vyjimkou-jsou-portlik-s_2610141600_cen</link>
 <description>V Česku se po komunálních volbách vyjednává o koalicích. Jasno je po úterku o složení magistrátu v Olomouci a Jablonci nad Nisou. Naopak jednání ve třech největších českých městech – Praze, Brně a Ostravě – dál pokračují. „V Praze je mezi politiky velká řevnivost, možná i nenávist. Jedinou výjimkou je vztah Tomáš Portlík – Petr Hlaváček,“ přibližuje v Ranním Plusu politický reportér Seznam Zpráv Václav Dolejší.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/a37c66249a8f190d1a0a76aee733fadf.jpg?itok=QyxZGwMA" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Městům na Vysočině chybí strážníci městské policie. V Třebíči hledají posily dlouhodobě</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/mestum-na-vysocine-chybi-straznici-mestske-policie-v-trebici-hledaji-posily_2610141526_jor</link>
 <description>Dohled nad dopravou ve městě nebo zásahy u drobnějších přestupků – hlavní náplň práce městských strážníků v některých sídlech na Vysočině zastává méně lidí, než by bylo potřeba. Nové síly poptává dlouhodobě například městská policie v Třebíči. „Strážníci nám odcházejí průběžně například do důchodu nebo k Policii České republiky,“ přibližuje pro Český rozhlas Vysočina její mluvčí Daniela Nosková.</description>

</item>
<item>
 <title>Poslechněte si senátní duel z obvodu 36 – Česká Lípa: Jitka Volfová vs. Martin Půta</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/volby/poslechnete-si-senatni-duel-z-obvodu-36-ceska-lipa-jitka-volfova-vs-martin-puta_2610141505_ako</link>
 <description>V obvodě č. 36 Česká Lípa se o senátorský post ucházelo celkem pět kandidátů. Do druhého kola postoupila poslankyně a starostka České Lípy za ANO Jitka Volfová s podporou 35 procent hlasů. A také hejtman Libereckého kraje z hnutí Starostové pro Liberecký kraj Martin Půta, který v prvním kole získal 32,7 procenta. Poslechněte si jejich duel.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/debata-senat-ceska_l_261014-135219_ako.jpg?itok=39T1l6T1" type="image/jpeg" />

<item>
 <title>Místo dvaceti minut tři čtvrtě hodiny. Uzavírka tunelů v Brně způsobuje kolony, někde dopravu řídí policie</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/misto-dvaceti-minut-tri-ctvrte-hodiny-uzavirka-tunelu-v-brne-zpusobuje-kolony_2610141431_neb</link>
 <description>Uzavírka Pisáreckého tunelu a tunelu Hlinky už několik dní komplikuje dopravu v Brně. V jihozápadní části města se tvoří kolony, v některých místech policisté dokonce museli vypnout semafory a dopravu řídí sami. Je teď v Brně rychlejší jet autem, nebo městskou hromadnou dopravou? Obě varianty ve středu v ranní špičce vyzkoušely reportérky Českého rozhlasu Brno.</description>

</item>
<item>
 <title>Pavlovo veto padlo. Poslanci schválili zrušení pravomoci prezidenta i pravidla pro státní úředníky</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/pavlovo-veto-padlo-poslanci-schvalili-zruseni-pravomoci-prezidenta-i-pravidla_2610141421_ako</link>
 <description>Koaliční poslanci ve středu přehlasovali veto prezidenta Petra Pavla. Díky vládní většině potvrdili zrušení pravomoci prezidenta republiky pověřovat a odvolávat vedoucí stálých misí u mezinárodních organizací. Spolu s tím schválili také návrh nového zákona o státních zaměstnancích, jenž má podle tvůrců usnadnit výměnu státních úředníků a přiblížit pravidla jejich zaměstnávání zákoníku práce.</description>

   <description>Bydlet v pronajatém bytě už není jen dočasné řešení. Lidé v něm budou zůstávat dlouho, někteří trvale.    <description>Dálniční síť v České republice se v letošním roce rozšíří o více než čtyřicet nových kilometrů. Mnohé úseky budou zprovozněné ke konci roku a po některých z nich budou moci řidiči zpočátku jezdit zadarmo. Od ledna se to však změní. Ministerstvo dopravy totiž plánuje jejich zpoplatnění. Změny se netýkají jen osobních aut, resort má připravené také rozšíření mýtného pro nákladní dopravu.</description>

   <link>https://www.denik.cz/evropa-pro-cechy/plosne-smirovani-mobilu-narizene-bruselem-policii-moc-nepomaha-rika-gregorova/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=evropa-pro-cechy</link>
   <description>V dalším dílu Evropy pro Čechy se podíváme do Štrasburku, sídla Evropského parlamentu. Zde se budeme s europoslankyní České pirátské strany Markétou Gregorovou o nejdůležitějších krocích Evropské unie v digitální oblasti, zákazu sociálních sítí a „šmírovacím aktu“ zvaném Chat Control. Ten především mezi mladou generací Čechů silně rezonuje a ptají se, zda to v EU neskončí podobně jako v Číně, která kontroluje veškerou komunikaci svého obyvatelstva.</description>

   <title>Děsivé statistiky. Každou hodinu zemře v Česku kvůli alkoholu jeden člověk</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/krimi/cesko-alkohol-rocne-v-cr-zemre-9500-lidi-kazdou-hodinu-jeden/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=krimi</link>
   <description>Metanolová aféra, která naplno propukla na začátku září 2012, představuje největší masovou otravu v novodobé historii země. Směs etanolu a vysoce toxického metanolu, kterou namíchala a prodávala skupina podvodníků, stála život 51 lidí a stovkám dalších způsobila trvalé následky včetně slepoty. Země se však dodnes s pitím levné kořalky nevyrovnala. Každou hodinu umře v ČR kvůli alkoholu jeden člověk.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Euroklíč s prodlevou. Handicapovaní se dočkají nejdříve o Vánocích</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/euroklic-s-prodlevou-handicapovani-se-dockaji-nejdrive-o-vanocich.A261014_154353_domaci_meli#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Žadatelé o euroklíč, který slouží zdravotně postiženým osobám k přístupu do veřejných sociálních a kompenzačních zařízení, si budou muset se svou žádankou v nejbližší době počkat. Národní rada osob se zdravotním postižením ve své zprávě uvedla, že byl projekt při nástupu nové vlády ukončen a dotační titul bude teprve vyhlášen. Zdravotně postižení tak budou muset vyčkat nejdříve do Vánoc. Distribuce by však mohla začít až začátkem příštího roku.</description>

      <description>Zpěv ve sboru, tanec nebo třeba výtvarná dílna. I takové aktivity by v budoucnu mohli lékaři doporučovat lidem, kteří se potýkají s úzkostmi, depresivními příznaky či osamělostí.       <link>https://www.idnes.cz/ekonomika/domaci/potraviny-pekarny-pecivo-zamestnanost-skolstvi.A261014_142753_ekonomika_drh#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Nárůst nákladů, který od loňska ještě zrychlil, není podle Svazu pekařů a cukrářů největším problémem jejich oboru. V pekařině totiž chybí tolik lidí, že brzy spolu se stárnutím současných pracovníků dojde k nárazu do zdi. Ročně vystuduje obor necelých 200 učňů, z nich reálně do pekáren nastoupí zhruba 50, říká výkonný ředitel svazu Bohumil Hlavatý. Na celkovou obměnu současných pracovníků by se tak čekalo 200 let.</description>

      <description>Snímky přehrady Hracholusky na Plzeňsku nabízejí v posledních týdnech neobvyklou podívanou.       <description>Během stavby nové tramvajové trati a rekonstrukcí té stávající mezi Nákladovým nádražím Žižkov a Ohradou se očekávaly dopravní komplikace. A ty skutečně přišly. <item>
<title>Nový AI projekt Tomáše Čupra už nasbíral přes miliardu. Teď míří do Ameriky</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/novy-ai-projekt-tomase-cupra-uz-nasbiral-pres-miliardu-ted-miri-do-ameriky/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Tomá&#353; Čupr, zakladatel Rohlíku, získal pro svůj startup Duvo dal&#353;ích 32 milionů dolarů, v přepočtu kolem 700 milionů Kč. Celkově na něj tak už nasbíral přes miliardu korun. Nové peníze přicházejí hlavně ze zahraničí &#8211; investiční kolo vedl londýnský fond Balderton Capital, ale přispěli i dosavadní investoři Index Ventures, Northzone a český Credo Ventures.</description>

<item>
<title>T-Mobile vypustil na zákaznickou linku AI, která vám vysvětlí třeba vyúčtování. Když se osvědčí, půjde z Česka do světa</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/t-mobile-vypustil-na-zakaznickou-linku-ai-ktera-vam-vysvetli-treba-vyuctovani-kdyz-se-osvedci-pujde-z-ceska-do-sveta/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Český T-Mobile nasadil na zákaznickou infolinku hlasového AI asistenta, který dokáže odpovídat na běžné dotazy k vyúčtování, roamingu nebo službám operátora. Zatímco běžné hlasové automaty zákazníka zpravidla navigují přes předem dané nabídky, asistent zvaný VoiceBot má rozumět konkrétním dotazům a rovnou na ně odpovídat. Česká pobočka má vedoucí roli v projektu, který chce mateřská Deutsche Telekom rozvíjet i v dal&#353;ích zemích. Technologii navíc dodává ceněný startup, kde mají podíl i Če&#353;i.</description>

<author>redakce@lupa.cz (Lupa.cz: Iva Brejlová)</author>
<pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 12:36:28 GMT</pubDate>
<enclosure url="https://i.iinfo.cz/images/428/mobilni-telefon-smartphone-ruka-1.jpg" length='30901' type="image/jpeg"/>

<description>V Česku vzniklo trži&#353;tě s aplikacemi s mezinárodními ambicemi. Jde o podobný koncept, jaký prosazují velké cloudové a softwarové společnosti typu Amazon Web Services, Salesforce.com a dal&#353;í. Ty z jednoho místa umožňují nákup dal&#353;ích cloudových appek s jednou fakturací, integrací a podobně. Původní inspirace pro tento koncept přichází z Apple App Store a Google Play Store.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-101-kilometru-ctverecnich-ukrajinska-armada-oznamila-ze-osvobodila-dalsi_2610141655_lhv</link>
 <description>Ukrajinské síly dokázaly díky operaci Vivaldi osvobodit od ruské okupace dalších 101 kilometrů čtverečních území, oznámil velitel 3. armádního sboru ukrajinské armády Andrij Bileckyj. Napsal to server Ukrainska pravda s odvoláním na příspěvek na telegramovém účtu armádního sboru. Armáda osvobodila obce Zelena Dolyna, Lypove a Koloďazi v Doněcké oblasti.</description>

<item>
 <title>Nedůvěra Američanů ve volby roste. Čeho se bojí republikáni a čeho demokraté?</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/neduvera-americanu-ve-volby-roste-ceho-se-boji-republikani-a-ceho-demokrate_2610141641_jar</link>
 <description>Méně než polovina Američanů očekává, že listopadové volby do Kongresu budou svobodné a spravedlivé. Podle agentury Gallup navíc ve Spojených státech poctivosti voleb více důvěřují odpůrci současné americké administrativy než její příznivci. Co se může stát, pokud některá ze stran odmítne uznat jejich výsledky? Tématu se věnují Jana Ciglerová a Jan Kaliba v novém díle podcastu Přes Atlantik.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/61521f5eaebc4d08447d70262a522399.jpg?itok=FyGghFpw" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>U Hormuzského průlivu se po zásahu projektilem potopila kontejnerová loď, další je poškozená</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/u-hormuzskeho-prulivu-se-po-zasahu-projektilem-potopila-kontejnerova-lod-dalsi_2610141606_lhv</link>
 <description>Poblíž Hormuzského průlivu se ve středu po zásahu projektilem potopila kontejnerová loď plující pod singapurskou vlajkou, další nákladní loď byla poškozena, informovala agentura Reuters s odvoláním na bezpečnostní zdroje. Na plavidla v úžině klíčové pro přepravu ropy útočí Írán od chvíle, kdy Spojené státy a Izrael v únoru zahájily údery proti Teheránu.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/02455076.jpeg?itok=J5Yc7rUC" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 16:06:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Evropská komise navrhla roční odklad klíčových povinností nařízení o metanu. Babiš to uvítal</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/evropska-komise-navrhla-rocni-odklad-klicovych-povinnosti-narizeni-o-metanu_2610141127_vaa</link>
 <description>Evropská komise (EK) navrhla roční odklad klíčových povinností metanového nařízení pro dováženou ropu a plyn. EK o tom informovala ve svém prohlášení. O odklad usilovala mimo jiné Česká republika, která následně získala podporu dalších 19 států včetně Německa. Praha prosazovala až tříletý odklad, Francie navrhovala jeden rok. Rozhodnutí komise uvítal český premiér Andrej Babiš (hnutí ANO).</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/zuj_7748_240829-232319_zuj.jpg?itok=PW-Pwr4C" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:27:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>‚Odvolám se.‘ Davis dostal za zosnování vraždy Tupaca 40 let vězení, hádal se kvůli odsezenému trestu</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/odvolam-se-davis-dostal-za-zosnovani-vrazdy-tupaca-40-let-vezeni-hadal-se-kvuli_2610140955_vaa</link>
 <description>Duane Davis, který se podle soudu podílel na vraždě amerického rapera Tupaca před třiceti lety, stráví zřejmě zbytek života ve vězení. Někdejšího vůdce gangu známého jako Keffe D shledala porota vinným v srpnu. Šedesátníkovi aktuálně soudkyně vyměřila trest nejméně čtyřicetiletého vězení. Odsouzený se odvolá.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-08-31t100017z_1_260901-114601_lar.JPG?itok=by3pOPkl" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:55:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>SpaceX omezil na Ukrajině Starlink. Podle Kyjeva to narušilo bojové operace</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-spacex-omezil-na-ukrajine-starlink-podle-kyjeva-narusilo-bojove-operace_2610140915_vaa</link>
 <description>Společnost SpaceX v noci omezila na Ukrajině některé služby družicové sítě Starlink. Narušilo to bojové operace, protože armáda o tom dopředu nevěděla. Uvedl to ve středu poradce ukrajinského prezidenta Serhij Beskrestnov. Firma SpaceX miliardáře Elona Muska se k tomu zatím nevyjádřila.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/profimedia-101856977_250915-103607_duk.jpg?itok=pvsOQ__h" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:13:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Rusko zasáhlo energetická zařízení v Kyjevě. Útoky zabily na Ukrajině šest lidí</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-rusko-zautocilo-na-energeticka-zarizeni-v-kyjeve-jeden-clovek-zemrel_2610140629_vaa</link>
 <description>Při ruských nočních útocích na Ukrajinu bylo zabito nejméně šest lidí, píše agentura AFP s odvoláním na tamní úřady. Tři lidé zahynuli v Kyjevě, dva v Dněpropetrovské oblasti a jeden v Záporožské oblasti. V Kyjevě Rusko zasáhlo balistickými střelami energetická zařízení. Ve městě nastaly výpadky dodávek elektřiny, uvedl ve středu ráno starosta ukrajinské metropole Vitalij Kličko.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-10-13t215115z_1_261014-062020_vaa.JPG?itok=vYZU6Ohj" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 06:29:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Okopávači kotníků, nástroj Íránu. Húsíové dostali Saúdy pod tlak a Američané se bojí nové fronty</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/okopavaci-kotniku-nastroj-iranu-husiove-dostali-saudy-pod-tlak-a-americane-se_2610140600_med</link>
 <description>Prodloužená ruka Íránu, jemenští rebelové, povstalci – Húsíové. Kde se vzali a za co vlastně bojují?</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/63ba0da0ea9ab585f5e207d6625c25ba.jpg?itok=WwXqQAgG" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 06:00:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Davis dostal za zosnování vraždy Tupaca 40 let až doživotí. Rozsudek padl 30 let po zabití rapera</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/davis-dostal-za-zosnovani-vrazdy-tupaca-40-let-az-dozivoti-rozsudek-padl-30-let_2610132211_mst</link>
 <description>Někdejší vůdce gangu Duane „Keffe D“ Davis byl za zosnování vraždy 25letého rapera Tupaca Shakura v roce 1996 nyní odsouzen ke 40 letům až doživotí za mřížemi, píše agentura AP. O podmínečné propuštění bude 63letý Davis moci požádat nejdříve za 40 let, zbytek života tak nejspíš stráví ve vězení. Porota v srpnu Davise shledala vinným z vraždy smrtící zbraní se záměrem propagovat kriminální gang, upevnit jeho pozici či mu pomoci Shakurovou smrtí.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-08-25t222619z_7_261013-214236_mst.JPG?itok=2RfQJQJQ" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Tue, 13 Oct 2026 22:11:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Lev XIV. měl zhoubný nádor plic. Lékaři mu ho odebrali, papež se má zotavovat týden</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/papez-lev-xiv-mel-zhoubny-nador-plic-lekari-mu-ho-odebrali_2610132208_mst</link>
 <description>Papež Lev XIV. měl zhoubný nádor plic, jak ukázalo vyšetření plicního laloku, který mu v úterý lékaři odebrali při operaci v římské nemocnici. Podle agentury Reuters o tom informoval Vatikán. Už dříve uvedl, že operace dopadla dobře. Papež se má zotavovat přibližně týden. </description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-09-17t105901z_3_261013-221244_mst.JPG?itok=jnqqOWvJ" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Tue, 13 Oct 2026 22:08:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>

news.rawText:
Kudy z nudy – Žebříčky: Liberecký kraj Žebříčky RSS Feed <![CDATA[Šťastné a křišťálové – Vánoce naruby]]>

Přijďte prožít advent do libereckého Paláce Liebieg, kde se letos potkají tradice, kreativita a vánoční atmosféra Křišťálového údolí. Čeká vás jedinečná výstava, která vás zavede do světa fantazie, kde nic není takové, jak se na první pohled zdá.

]]> Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:54:49 GMT <![CDATA[Židovská modlitebna a synagoga Liberec]]>

Novodobá liberecká synagoga je součástí Krajské vědecké knihovny, známé jako Stavba smíření. Otevřena byla roku 2000 na místě synagogy vypálené nacisty. Trojúhelníkový půdorys připomíná část Davidovy hvězdy a interiér uchovává památky původního svatostánku.

]]> Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:36:28 GMT <![CDATA[Kostel sv. Vojtěcha v Liberci]]>

Kostel sv. Vojtěcha v libereckém Ostašově stojí na místě dřevěné kaple vybudované z odškodnění za sedmiletou válku. Zděná stavba vznikla v letech 1832–1833. Díky péči Spolku přátel Ostašova dnes ožívá koncerty a dalšími kulturními akcemi.

]]> Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:29:30 GMT <![CDATA[Kostel sv. Jana Křtitele v Liberci]]>

Barokní kostel sv. Jana Křtitele v liberecké Rochlici stojí na místě někdejšího dřevěného evangelického kostela. Zaujme dochovaným historickým vybavením, hlavním oltářem s obrazem patrona chrámu, vyřezávanou kazatelnou a varhanami z roku 1887.

]]> Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:23:32 GMT

Univerzitu studuje 1 100 studentů 50+</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902955-obri-boom-seniorskeho-studia-v-liberci-univerzitu-studuje-1-100-studentu-50.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902955-obri-boom-seniorskeho-studia-v-liberci-univerzitu-studuje-1-100-studentu-50.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 15:02:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Univerzita třetího věku (U3V) pro studující 50+ poprvé za téměř 30 let své existence pod hlavičkou Technické univerzity v Liberci pokořila hranici 1 000 zapsaných posluchaček a posluchačů, a to o parník: v tomto semestru ji studuje 1 106 seniorů a seniorek.</description></item><item><title>Liberecká pobočka Popeyes v centru města nečekaně zavřela. Kdy opět otevře?</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902958-liberecka-pobocka-popeyes-v-centru-liberce-necekane-zavrela-kdy-opet-otevre.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902958-liberecka-pobocka-popeyes-v-centru-liberce-necekane-zavrela-kdy-opet-otevre.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 13:00:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Restaurace Popeyes v libereckém OC Forum musela nečekaně přerušit provoz. Za dočasným uzavřením stojí technický problém v obchodním centru. Milovníci ikonického kuřete se však nemusí obávat, podle vedení značky se brány pobočky opět otevřou již během několika dnů.</description></item><item><title>Žádný nudný salát. Pražský Roots project uspěl s nutričními jídly</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902774-zadny-nudny-salat-prazsky-roots-project-uspel-s-nutricnimi-jidly.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902774-zadny-nudny-salat-prazsky-roots-project-uspel-s-nutricnimi-jidly.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:56:00 +0200</pubDate><category>Společnost</category><description>Víte přesně, kolik kalorií a bílkovin má váš oběd? Spolumajitelka úspěšného pražského bistra Roots project Rosie Smolenová se rozhodla změnit pohled na zdravé stravování. Vytvořila koncept vyvážených pokrmů, kde zákazníci přesně ví, co jí.</description></item><item><title>Řidič před OBI zastavil přes tři místa pro osoby se zdravotním postižením</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/902950-ridic-pred-obi-zastavil-pres-tri-mista-pro-osoby-se-zdravotnim-postizenim.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/902950-ridic-pred-obi-zastavil-pres-tri-mista-pro-osoby-se-zdravotnim-postizenim.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:44:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Strážníci z České Lípy zveřejnili fotografii rekordmana. Tentokrát ale v negativním smyslu, šlo totiž o řidiče, který před tamním OBI zaparkoval na místech vyhrazených pro osoby se zdravotním postižením. A šlo o místa rovnou tři.</description></item><item><title>Soud zrušil verdikt v kauze Walderode, chybí přesnější identifikace pozemků</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902940-soud-zrusil-verdikt-v-kauze-walderode-chybi-presnejsi-identifikace-pozemku.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902940-soud-zrusil-verdikt-v-kauze-walderode-chybi-presnejsi-identifikace-pozemku.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 06:34:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Odvolací Krajský soud v Hradci Králové zrušil rozhodnutí Okresního soudu v Semilech v restituční kauze Walderode. Soud žádá přesnější identifikaci více než tisícovky pozemků, o které žádá Johanna Kammerlanderová, vdova po Karlovi des Fours Walderode.</description></item><item><title>Konec omezení v Hodkovicích. Most přes silnici 35 se otevře</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/902885-konec-omezeni-hodkovicich-most-pres-silnici-35-se-otevre.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/902885-konec-omezeni-hodkovicich-most-pres-silnici-35-se-otevre.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 13 Oct 2026 20:01:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Už ve čtvrtek se otevře most přes silnici I/35 v Hodkovicích, po půl roce tak skončí dopravní omezení v okolí mostu. Výměna mostu ŘSD přišla na 72 milionů korun.</description></item><item><title>Co se dělo minulý týden? Prověřte své znalosti v křížovce</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kvizy/902855-co-se-delo-minuly-tyden-proverte-sve-znalosti-v-krizovce.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kvizy/902855-co-se-delo-minuly-tyden-proverte-sve-znalosti-v-krizovce.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 13 Oct 2026 18:15:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Kvízy</category><description>Pojďte se pobavit a připomenout si, o čem Liberecká Drbna psala minulý týden. Přinášíme novou várku křižovek.</description></item><item><title>Darujte nevyužité vánoční ozdoby, pomůžete onkologicky nemocným v kraji</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902835-darujte-nevyuzite-vanocni-ozdoby-pomuzete-onkologicky-nemocnym-v-kraji.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/902835-darujte-nevyuzite-vanocni-ozdoby-pomuzete-onkologicky-nemocnym-v-kraji.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:00:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Centrum Amelie Liberec vyhlašuje tradiční sbírku vánočních dekorací. Nepotřebné ozdoby, které doma jen leží, můžete do 30. listopadu věnovat na sběrných místech. Jejich následný prodej pomůže financovat bezplatnou psychosociální péči pro onkologicky nemocné a jejich rodiny.</description></item><item><title>Tragická nehoda v Jablonci. Couvající dodávka srazila muže, zemřel</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/902918-tragicka-nehoda-v-jablonci-couvajici-dodavka-srazila-muze-zemrel.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/902918-tragicka-nehoda-v-jablonci-couvajici-dodavka-srazila-muze-zemrel.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 13 Oct 2026 14:12:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Tragická dopravní nehoda se dnes dopoledne stala v Jablonci nad Nisou v Pražské ulici. Řidič kurýrní dodávky při couvání přehlédl muže, který vstoupil do vozovky zpoza nákladního auta. Chodec přes veškerou snahu záchranářů na místě svému zranění podlehl.</description></item></channel></rss>
